# BillingBee

> BillingBee is an AI-powered invoicing SaaS built for Indian freelancers and small businesses.

## Product

BillingBee lets you create, send, and manage invoices using natural language commands. No forms, no friction — just describe what you need and the AI handles the rest.

## Key Features

- Natural language invoice creation
- GST-compliant invoices for Indian businesses
- Client portal for online payments
- Multi-currency support
- Payment integrations: Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal
- Automated payment reminders
- Revenue and earnings analytics
- PDF invoice generation

## Pricing

- Free: Basic invoicing, up to 5 clients
- Pro: $9.99/month — unlimited clients, payment integrations, reminders
- Business: $24.99/month — team members, advanced analytics, white-labeling

## Natural Language Commands

- "Create invoice for Acme Corp for ₹50,000 for web design"
- "Show unpaid invoices"
- "How much did I earn this month?"
- "Send reminder to clients with overdue invoices"
- "Mark invoice #42 as paid"
